current.text: The newest Boston preview projects him in the bench rotation, with Baylor Scheierman starting. The same expert says he still has a chance to start.
Boston is very deep, with at least 12 rotation-level players. In a 10-man rotation some of them will miss out most nights.
He finished 282nd in category leagues last season.
His Yahoo ADP of 102 is far too high. He is a deep-league option only.

durable.text: He is a veteran catch-and-shoot player who shoots about 40% from three and does not try to do too much.
He is a deep-league rotation player who hits a lot of threes and offers little else.
Threes and low turnovers are his only categories clearly above the pool. Steals, assists, points and FG% are below it, and he takes so few free throws that his FT% barely matters.

note: Yahoo and ESPN both value him at 0 USD and rank him 181 and 167, outside the 144 players our league drafts, and the expert calls him a deep-league player only. He is not a draft target. His only uses are threes and very few turnovers, and his FG% (43.0% projected) and empty steals, assists and points cost a 12-team roster. Early in the season, check whether he starts over Baylor Scheierman. Even then he is at most a short-term 3PM streamer from waivers.
